name: Orb Universal Interatomic Potential
one_liner: A universal interatomic potential (graph network) for atomistic modelling of materials; denoising diffusion pretraining only initialises the potential, which predicts energy, forces and stress.

loop.proposes: Orb is a universal interatomic potential, not a generative search; denoising pretraining only initialises the potential.
loop.judged_by: The potential predicts energy, forces and stress.
loop.steers: No generative search; the model is trained in two phases, denoising diffusion pretraining and then the interatomic potential.

headline_result: Topped the Matbench Discovery leaderboard for predicting stable inorganic crystals at 3-6x higher relaxation speed than prior equivariant potentials.
caveat: Learned universal potentials lack explicit long-range electrostatics unless augmented with Ewald summation terms.
beyond_harness_note: A universal interatomic potential, trained first as a denoising diffusion model and then as a neural network potential; it is not a generative search.
generative_model: Graph network interatomic potential, initialised from a denoising diffusion pretraining phase
algorithmic_authority: None in the loop: the potential predicts energy, forces and stress, and it is not a generative search

sources.title: Orb: A Fast, Scalable Neural Network Potential (arXiv:2410.22570)

verification.notes: Checked against Neumann et al., arXiv:2410.22570.
